items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Mark went with Roy, Roberto, Bob Coquille. Oh yeah, Bob went with him.

ctx.x: Yeah, you ain't kidding. Mike's working at Doha now. He is? Relief, relief band. Oh yeah.

Who that's Roy still down there? Somebody told me Roy went with Roy, Roberto. Yeah? Yeah, they had a real uh... Push out, huh? Yeah. All Bourbon Street has changed now recently. Yeah, I guess so. Mark went with Roy, Roberto, Bob Coquille. Oh yeah, Bob went with him.
Well who are those they call the Confederate colonels? Little Cree, Armand Kay. Oh yeah, Armand Kay?
